verdict.rationale: Rainforest documents its own sandbox environment, marketed as "full end-to-end sandbox testing". It provides test card and bank account numbers with deterministic approved or declined outcomes, and the going-live docs describe distinct integration phases. The evidence never explicitly states that sandbox data and credentials are isolated from production, so coverage is partial. missing for 10: explicit documentation of separate sandbox vs. production environments, keys and data isolation, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data

citations.quote: Any card number *not* included in any list below will result in a generic **Declined** payment in the sandbox environment.
Any valid routing + account number will result in an **Approved** payment in the sandbox environment.
